key_highlights: Fed lifts rates to 4pc, spooking global markets; RBA now more likely to follow with a hike, pressuring AUD and ASX
ASX volatile: gained on easing oil intraday but slid to three-month low as banks and miners fell on oil jump and rate fears
AUD crushed on Fed 'Warshach test' failure; 10-year US yield surges to 19-year high, elevating global risk-off sentiment
IMF urges Australian government to cut spending ahead of another RBA rate hike; state interest costs soaring
Mining sector mixed: record gold grades (Aguia), rare earth discovery (Barkly NT), Burbanks plant fast-tracked (Auric), but miners under pressure on oil-driven risk-off
Consumer distress: Cue and Veronika Maine up for sale after 58 years; real wages growth crushed by exploited workers; Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling major tech infrastructure investment in Australia
Chinese growth 'sinks from sight'; Yuan crude oil futures hit record high, adding commodity volatility
Diesel prices spike and east-coast fuel supply crunch hits distributors; green hydrogen spending under political scrutiny
ACCC moves to break real estate monopoly; Trump mulls policies that could crash Australian house prices

sectors.trend: Mixed: miners fell on risk-off and oil volatility, but gold grades (Aguia), rare earths (Barkly NT), and Burbanks (Auric) provide structural upside. Chinese growth slowdown pressures iron ore demand.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from Chinese demand weakness and oil-driven risk-off. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, BRL.AX) offer relative strength. Auric (AUR.AX) benefits from Burbanks fast-track.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rising rate expectations, soaring state interest costs, and credit concerns. Bathla insolvency storm signals broader credit stress. Private credit expansion flagged as risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility and credit cycle concerns. Rising state debt (headline 2) pressures sovereign credit. Private credit exposure (headline 32) a tail risk.

sectors.trend: Oil prices volatile (eased then jumped); diesel spikes; east-coast fuel supply crunch. Green hydrogen spending under political attack. China's Yuan crude at record high adds uncertainty.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face input cost pressure from diesel. LNG names (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from commodity strength. Green hydrogen projects face policy risk.

sectors.trend: Severely stressed: Cue and Veronika Maine collapse; real wages growth crushed; exploited workers; Bathla insolvency. Consumer spending power deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, IAG.AX face demand headwinds. Discount retailers (WOW.AX, LNE.AX) may benefit from trade-down. Superannuation reform debate (headlines 36, 59) could shift fund flows.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major capex cycle. AI infrastructure buildout accelerating in Australia. Cathie Wood sells crypto stocks amid rally.
sectors.implications: Datacentre and infrastructure names (SGH.AX, VCN.AX) benefit. Tech sector (W1.AX, XRO.AX) supported by AI capex. Crypto exposure (COG.AX, etc.) volatile.

sectors.trend: ACCC targeting real estate monopoly; Trump mulls policies to crash house prices; housing trust mould issues signal quality concerns. Rising rates pressure valuations.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face rate-driven yield pressure. Residential property (MRG.AX, LVH.AX) under policy risk. Commercial REITs may benefit from ACCC reform.

key_themes: Fed rate hike to 4pc and RBA follow-on risk dominate global and domestic sentiment
AUD weakness and 10-year yield at 19-year high create headwinds for rate-sensitive sectors
Chinese growth deceleration threatens iron ore and commodity demand
Consumer distress and insolvency wave (Bathla, Cue, Veronika Maine) signal economic fragility
Mining sector bifurcated: gold/rare earths strong, iron ore/coal under pressure
AI infrastructure super-cycle (Anthropic $31bn QLD) a structural positive for Australian tech
Energy supply crunch and diesel volatility threaten transport and logistics margins
Superannuation reform debate could reshape fund flows and retirement sector

defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed, 10-year yield at 19-year high, RBA hike likely; REITs face valuation compression

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor credit quality in banks and private credit
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla insolvency storm, private credit expansion, and state debt stress raise default risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA rate hike probability elevated post-Fed 4pc move. AUD weakness and 10-year yield spike cap multiples. Miners and banks vulnerable. Gold, healthcare, and staples offer relative strength. Volatility elevated ahead of RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA peaks and Chinese stimulus materialises. AI infrastructure capex (Anthropic $31bn), rare earths, and gold provide structural themes. Consumer recovery uncertain given wage stagnation and insolvency wave. Superannuation reform could redirect fund flows. Key risk: prolonged global rate cycle and Chinese demand weakness.
